skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Take a Leap
skins.content: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Take a Leap. Green jacket over a simple shirt, with a pair of jeans and protective pads. Very easy to move in, making it well-suited for the outdoors.
skins.quote: Jackie leaps into the air, grabs the banner at the center of the mall, falls down onto one of the stalls from the ground floor convention, takes out a few bad guys with a stool, then runs away.
